q: During a predictive project, the team faces a recurring problem with late material deliveries. What should the project manager do to solve the problem?
options: Work with the team to analyse root causes and agree corrective actions
Replace the supplier immediately without analysing the cause of delays
Ask the procurement team to solve the problem without involving the team
Accept late deliveries as normal and add buffer time to every activity

feedback.A: Correct. Problem-solving involves the team in analysing root causes and agreeing actions.
feedback.B: Incorrect. Replacing without analysis may not fix the cause.
feedback.C: Incorrect. Procurement may help, but the team knows the impacts.
feedback.D: Incorrect. Padding all activities hides the problem.

explain: Problem-solving involves the team in analysing root causes and agreeing actions.

q: Which document shows how much money is needed in each period of a predictive project?
options: Cost estimates
Funding requirements
Basis of estimates
Risk register

feedback.A: Incorrect. Cost estimates give activity costs, not the funding profile.
feedback.B: Correct. Funding requirements show the total and periodic funding needs derived from the cost baseline.
feedback.C: Incorrect. The basis of estimates explains how estimates were made.
feedback.D: Incorrect. The risk register records risks.

explain: Funding requirements show the total and periodic funding needs derived from the cost baseline.

q: A hybrid project is starting. How should the project manager plan how risk will be managed across both workstreams?
options: Copy the risk management plan from a previous predictive project unchanged
Ask each workstream to manage risks in its own way
Develop one tailored risk management plan for both
Wait until risks appear and then decide how to manage them

feedback.A: Incorrect. An unchanged predictive plan may not suit adaptive work.
feedback.B: Incorrect. Separate methods prevent consistent assessment.
feedback.C: Correct. A risk management plan sets out how risk management will be performed, tailored to the project's approaches.
feedback.D: Incorrect. Reactive management misses early responses.

explain: A risk management plan sets out how risk management will be performed, tailored to the project's approaches.

q: A hybrid project to develop a ride-share platform learns that two competitors have merged and are cutting prices. What should the project manager do?
options: Match the competitors' prices in the next release without analysis
Continue as planned, since competitor moves are outside project scope
Stop the project until the market settles after the merger
Assess the impact on the value case and reprioritise with stakeholders

feedback.A: Incorrect. Reacting without analysis may harm value.
feedback.B: Incorrect. Ignoring the market risks irrelevance.
feedback.D: Correct. Market changes are assessed and prioritised for their impact on the backlog and value case.

explain: Market changes are assessed and prioritised for their impact on the backlog and value case.

q: A predictive project manager wants to support a diverse team. Which TWO actions help?
options: Adapt communication to cultural differences
Invite different perspectives in problem-solving
Ignore cultural differences
Require everyone to work the same way
Assign tasks based on stereotypes

feedback.A: Correct choice. Supporting diversity involves adapting communication to differences.
feedback.B: Correct choice. Supporting diversity involves inviting different perspectives.
feedback.C: Incorrect choice. Ignoring differences causes misunderstanding.
feedback.E: Incorrect choice. Stereotypes are unfair and inaccurate.

explain: Supporting diversity involves inviting perspectives and adapting to differences.

q: An agile project's sponsor wants to know whether the product still delivers business value. Which THREE measures are MOST relevant?
options: Number of lines of code
Revenue or cost savings attributed to the product
Customer adoption rate
Hours worked by the team
Number of story points completed
Customer satisfaction scores

feedback.A: Incorrect choice. Lines of code measure output.
feedback.B: Correct choice. Financial impact is an outcome measure of business value.
feedback.C: Correct choice. Adoption is an outcome measure of business value.
feedback.E: Incorrect choice. Story points measure output.
feedback.F: Correct choice. Satisfaction is an outcome measure of business value.

explain: Business value is shown by outcome measures such as adoption, financial impact and satisfaction.

q: Before an agile project closes, the remaining product backlog should be [[F1]].
options: deleted, since the project is now closing
archived without assigning an owner
handed to the operational product owner
completed in full by the team

feedback.B: Incorrect. Unowned backlogs are not managed.
feedback.C: Correct. Residual backlog is handed to the owner of the product after the project.
feedback.D: Incorrect. Low-value items need not all be built.

explain: Residual backlog is handed to the owner of the product after the project.
